subject: Deal-linked capacity planning: timelines & vendor asks for Acme Retail Dedicated
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity ask for RDW-DEAL-2026-1198 — target start mid-May

Team,

Quick summary: Acme (Jared Mills) expects a production cutover window the week of 2026-05-18 for Dedicated capacity. The deal economics require us to guarantee a minimum committed throughput for month 1 (they want predictable latency under load). We need a concrete procurement & cloud hold timeline so Sales can lock the commitment in the MAP.

What I need from infra/procurement by EOW:
- Rough GPU count and preferred config (A100-80 / H100L / equivalent) for the first month + steady-state at Q3 forecast.
- OEM lead-time estimate and any expedite options (weeks + tradeoffs).
- Cloud reserved capacity lead time and minimum commit (weeks).
- Any blockers (quota, cabling/rack constraints, power).

Attachments: acme_mop_draft.pdf, demand_forecast_q2.csv (high-level expected qps & growth).

Karthik — can you confirm Acme's requested SLA and the committed start date in the MAP? I want to align vendor asks to that. Rafael/Dev/Naomi — please coordinate and drop a vendor outreach plan.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity ask for RDW-DEAL-2026-1198 — target start mid-May

Hannah / all,

I reviewed the forecast and ran a quick capacity calc against the model family they plan to use (open-llm-7b/16k context variants). Assumptions in initial_sizing.xlsx (attached):
- Target P95 latency target: 250ms token generation (real-time chat workload)
- Expected avg concurrent sessions month 1: 650
- Average token output per session: 120 tokens
- Avg request distribution -> mixed short/long; planning for 25% long-tail bursts

Sizing (conservative):
- Minimum Day 1 fleet: 48 x H100L (single-precision workload with KV caching); equivalent to ~72 A100-80GB nodes if using older generation.
- Steady-state (end Q3 ramp): 120 x H100L or equivalent.

Lead-time notes:
- OEM hardware (racked systems): standard delivery 10–14 weeks from PO for common configs, 14–18 weeks for custom thermal/power racks. Expedited handling possible (6–8 weeks) with premium fees and limited availability.
- Cloud capacity reservation: Cloud partners can hold soft capacity in ~2–3 weeks and firm reserved capacity in 6–8 weeks depending on region and instance family; verify exact SKU availability for H100L equivalents.
- Logistics: rack/cabling/power commissioning in customer DC or colo often adds 1–2 weeks on top of delivery.

Recommendation: target a hybrid plan — lock a cloud reserved tranche to cover first 8–12 weeks, concurrently place OEM PO for Day 30–60 handover to on-prem/dedicated fleet. That reduces risk if OEM delays occur.

I'll start drafting a vendor outreach email. Rafael — can you lead PO terms (payment schedule, expedite clauses)? Naomi — need cost delta numbers for the MAP.

— Dev

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Request for quote & capacity hold — RDW-DEAL-2026-1198 (Acme Retail)

Simon / Alexa / Jared,

Following up from internal sizing, Redwood needs firm lead-time and pricing for two parallel paths for Acme Retail:

1) OEM purchase (Titan):
- Initial config target: 48 H100L-class nodes (1U/2U mix per Titan standard configs).
- Add-on: NVMe caching tiers + 10GbE redundant NICs.
- Delivery window needed: ideally 10 weeks; latest acceptable 14 weeks. Please include expedited options and fees.

2) Cloud reserved tranche (CloudZone):
- Soft hold for 80 instances of H100L-equivalent (or closest SKU) for 6–8 weeks, with option to convert to reserved instances for 3 months.
- Need formal confirmation of hold and earliest activation date.

Procurement asks: lead times (weeks), volume discounts, payment milestones, expedite fees, and any regional constraints.

We plan to place a PO contingent on signed contract and a 30% deposit milestone. Please return an initial quote by EOD Wed 24 Mar so we can update the MAP and share to Acme.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Strategic Procurement, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for quote & capacity hold — RDW-DEAL-2026-1198 (Acme Retail)

Rafael, Hannah, team,

Thanks for the detailed ask. We can support the 48-node H100L-class order. Initial response below and attached quote (titan_quote_6789.pdf).

Estimated lead times (standard):
- Standard config (off-the-shelf rack & nodes): 8–10 weeks from PO.
- Custom rack layouts / non-standard power: 12–14 weeks.
- Expedited turnaround (fee applies): as fast as 6 weeks depending on factory sloting; expedite fee ~ 18% of HW spend.

Pricing notes:
- Base hardware (48-node) list: $3.45M. Net pricing and discounts available on 12-month payment terms / committed pipeline.
- NVMe cache + 10GbE NICs: +$120k.
- Support SLA: 24x7 hardware RMA, replacement part pool (optional).

Constraints / caveats:
- We can prioritize factory slotting for Redwood in April, which supports a 6–8 week window if PO is received by Mar 29 and expedite fee is accepted.
- Shipping lead times to the US West region add ~5 business days; customs not expected to be material for this order.

I'll plan a quick technical alignment call with Dev to confirm rack density and power draw on Thu morning. Rafael — I can convert attached PDF into a formal PO-ready quote once you confirm billing addresses and payment milestones.

Regards,
Simon Luo
Regional Sales, Titan OEM
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alexa Chen <alexa@cloudzone.com>, Jared Mills <procurement@acme-retail.com>, Simon Luo <simon.luo@titan-oems.com>

Subject: Re: Request for quote & capacity hold — RDW-DEAL-2026-1198 (Acme Retail)

Great progress — thank you. Quick summary and next steps so Sales can update the MAP and confirm commitments with Acme: 

1) OEM path (Titan):
- Simon confirmed 8–10 weeks standard, 6 weeks expedited if PO by Mar 29 + expedite fee (~18%).
- Rafael to confirm net pricing and issue PO-ready quote on receipt of billing details.

2) Cloud hold (CloudZone):
- Alexa: we need a soft hold for 80 instances (H100L-equivalent) starting mid-April; please confirm ability to convert to reserved instances and earliest activation window.

3) Recommended timeline:
- Week of Mar 29: finalize PO terms and either place expedited PO (if Acme accepts expedite fee) or place standard PO + cloud hold.
- Apr 05–Apr 12: cloud tranche available for validation & testing.
- May 18 week: target production cutover (per MAP).

Karthik — can you update the MAP to include the two-path contingency and capture the expedite fee checkbox for Acme approval? Rafael — please confirm you can deliver a PO-ready doc by EOD Mon 29 Mar. Alexa — please reply with the hold confirmation and a soft-hold id we can reference.

I'll schedule a vendor alignment call Thu 26 Mar 10am PT to sync rack/power details and convert quotes to PO-ready artifacts. Invite to follow.

Thanks all,
Hannah
